name: Bérchules (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a white saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bérchules (mountains and a river on green above a pomegranate).
history: Municipal flag of Bérchules; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Bérchules arms — mountains and river above a pomegranate
